currentCoordinate.coordNote: Ankeret er gjennomsnitt av publiserte UTM-punkter fra den historiske forvaltningsplanens transekter. Det representerer ikke gjeldende Z-APA-grense eller offentlig inngang og skal ikke verifiseres uten oppdatert polygon.

identity.currentName: Morro Casagrande – antigo Morro do Céu
identity.resolvedIdentity: The urban Atlantic Forest hill area now referred to municipally as Morro Casagrande, formerly the 2008 Morro do Céu municipal natural park
identity.identityProblem: The 2008 park law was revoked in 2021, while later planning documents retain a Morro Casagrande Z-APA context.
identity.splitReason: The historic park, current Z-APA planning area, forest fragment, source areas and trails refer to one evolving hill landscape.

requiredEvidence: documented public trailhead or observation anchor
legal crosswalk between the 2008 park, 2021 revocation and 2024 planning status

evidence.finding: Municipal planning material records the 2008 creation of Parque Natural Municipal Morro do Céu with 835,780.46 square metres and later used that park boundary in the Z-APA definition.
evidence.reason: Historical legal scope is documented, but the current polygon must be checked after later changes.

evidence.sourceName: Unesc – Morro do Céu management-plan biodiversity survey
evidence.finding: The survey used 14 transects, recorded 151 plant species and 75 bird species, and documented exotic plants, motorcycle and bicycle tracks and bird traps.
evidence.reason: Transect coordinates support only a derived candidate area anchor; they are not the current legal boundary.

evidence.sourceName: Criciúma gazette – Morro Casagrande, antigo Morro do Céu
evidence.finding: Municipal material uses Morro Casagrande and notes the former Morro do Céu identity in the context of the 2021 legal transition.
evidence.reason: Name and transition are resolved; current mapped scope remains outstanding.

evidence.finding: The 2024 plan lists Morro Casagrande among Z-APA areas requiring a management plan.
evidence.reason: Current planning status is clear, but the official area geometry was not captured.

decision.blockedReason: The place identity and source base are sufficient for production, but exact current geometry or a documented access/observation anchor is incomplete.
decision.nextAction: Capture the required polygon, centreline, entrance or access anchor and re-run coordinate review.

notes: The place must not be labelled as an uninterrupted current municipal park after the 2021 revocation.
The candidate point was derived from published research transects and is not an official centroid or access point.
